metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for video processing, transcription, subtitles, and dev workflow orchestration.

plugins.name: process-video
plugins.description: Process videos: optimize for web, transcribe audio with Deepgram Nova 3, add subtitles in any language, translate, and burn into video with customizable styles.

plugins.name: ralph
plugins.description: Native Claude-Code agentic loop: brainstorm → plan → execute → review → e2e → pr. Auto-routes single vs parallel-wave mode. Replaces the Docker-hosted ralphex flow; coexists with dev-workflow.

plugins.name: dev-workflow
plugins.description: Slash commands for orchestrated parallel ralphex plan execution, gated PR creation, test-first bug fixing, and visual preview sanity checks.
